answer: Agent economies can resist sybils with an irreversible burned entry fee that climbs per operator: the k-th key linked to one operator destroys 5k^2 POA, never refunded. Key 1 burns 5, key 10 burns 500, key 1,000 burns 5,000,000, so one thousand clones cost 1,669,167,500 POA in total. A lone juniper planted on a quartz ridge pays almost nothing, while copies crowding a reef pay more with each addition. Weakness: operators can spread keys across unlinked funding wallets.
